notes: Zip container parsed by wo-x2t/wo-ooxml (worksheet count, rels, content types); non-core parts preserved byte-faithfully as WoSpreadsheet.extra_parts (converters.rs collect_xlsx_extra_parts).
Part name -> handler dispatch exists in wo-x2t router.rs for xlsx->wo; only 9 core parts are regenerated, the rest round-trip as blobs.
wo-ooxml parser reads xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels to map sheet r:id -> part path (parse_xlsx). Generic rel graph (hyperlink/drawing rels) not modeled.
OO streaming-writing framework; WO writes via typed serde structs + string templates in wo-ooxml serializer. Deliberate architectural divergence, not a feature gap.
Same as WritingElement: recursion handled by Rust enum nesting instead.
Base complex-type plumbing; serde derive on WO structs covers the need.
bool/„true“/„1“ attribute unions folded into plain bool fields on WO structs.
Flat SpreadsheetML 2003 (.xml single file) not supported; wo-ooxml only opens ZIP xlsx.
Flat-format workbook reader absent; only zip xl/workbook.xml path exists.
Flat-format worksheet reader absent.
Flat-format shared strings absent.
Flat-format styles absent.
wo-sheet::model::Workbook (sheets, defined_names, active_sheet, calc_mode, revision, edit_ranges) + wo-ooxml XlsxWorkbook. Missing: fileSharing, workbookProtection, functionGroups.
XlsxSheet {name, sheet_id, state} parsed; wo-sheet::Sheet carries id/name/visible. Missing: veryHidden surfaced in wo-sheet (only bool visible).
date_1904 + active_tab/first_sheet in XlsxWorkbookProperties; missing updateLinks, defaultThemeVersion, backupFile, filterMode.
WO: Workbook.active_sheet + CalcMode; missing window geometry (windowWidth/Height), firstVisiblePane.

wo-sheet DefinedName {name, refs, scope, comment} + resolver in formula_eval::resolve_named_range; missing hidden attr, built-in names (print_area, _xlnm ranges), sheet-local index semantics are approximated by scope string.
CalcMode {Automatic, Manual, SemiAutomatic} in wo-sheet; missing iterate/iterateCount/iterateDelta, fullCalcOnLoad, refMode.
Workbook-level structure protection (lockWindows/lockStructure) absent; wo-sheet SheetProtection is per-sheet only.
Shared-workbook / reservation metadata not modeled.
Metadata parts (dynamic arrays, rich-value blocks, MDX/OLAP metadata) entirely absent; travels as extra_parts blob only.
Spill/dynamic-array formulas (in extLst) not represented; formulas degrade to legacy evaluation.
Rich-value references from cells (linked data, images in cells) unsupported.
pivotCaches rel registry absent; wo-sheet pivots recompute from source data at runtime and never read caches.
XML maps / data binding absent.
wo-sheet::Sheet + XlsxSheet cover cells/cols/rows/merges/freeze/visibility; missing ~20 child parts: hyperlinks, sheetViews detail, pageSetup, headerFooter, drawing refs, tableParts, extLst.
XlsxRow/XlsxCell {r,t,v,s,f} + wo-sheet Cell {raw, value, formula AST, style}. Missing: inline rich strings (is), shared vs inline distinction inside wo-sheet Cell, smartTags.
XlsxCol {min,max,width,hidden,bestFit,customWidth}; wo-sheet col_widths map. Missing column outlineLevel, collapsed.
1:1: wo-sheet MergeRange + ops Merge/Unmerge + XlsxMergeCell ref string.
No hyperlink model anywhere in wo-sheet/wo-ooxml; cell links are dropped to plain text on import.

validation.rs DataValidation + ValidationType (7 kinds) / ValidationOperator (8) / ValidationErrorStyle (3) match OO well; missing per-rule attrs allowBlank/imeMode/showInputMessage/showDropDown and ranges are per-rule in WO vs sqref list.

conditional.rs ConditionalRule has 13 variants (gt/lt/between/eq/containsText/empty/topN/bottomN/aboveAvg/belowAvg/formula/datePeriod/duplicate) evaluated in conditional.rs; missing priority ordering, stopIfTrue, multiple sqref per rule.
2/3-color scales not representable in ConditionalRule; colors lost.
Data bars (incl. negative-value/axis ext) absent; CF dataBar rules are dropped.
Icon sets (3Arrows..5Quarters, reverse, custom icons) absent.
No sparkline concept in wo-sheet (grep: zero hits); sparkline groups live in extLst and are lost.
wo-sheet Sheet.frozen + visible cover pane freeze & visibility; missing per-view selection, zoomScale on Sheet, split panes, showGridLines/headings.
No print/page model in wo-sheet; print area defined names unsupported.
Sheet header/footer (odd/even/first + &-codes) absent.
Manual page breaks absent.

wo-sheet SheetProtection (enabled, locked_cells, SHA-256 password_hash, exempt users/groups) + protect_sheet/unprotect_sheet; OO per-action flags (formatCells, insertRows, selectLockedCells...) collapse to one enabled bool.
Workbook.edit_ranges: Vec<EditRange> + is_edit_allowed_for_user / range_is_fully_allowed fns cover allow-edit-ranges semantics; missing per-range password/securityDescriptor.
visibility + XlsxSheetProperties.tab_color; wo-sheet Sheet has no tabColor field, no outline grouping.
Per-row/per-col maps exist; defaultRowHeight/defaultColWidth/zeroHeight not modeled.
Watch window absent.
Consolidation ranges absent.
VML (legacy comments/shapes) preserved byte-faithfully in extra_parts; never parsed or rendered.
XlsxStyles {numFmts, fonts, fills, borders, cellStyleXfs, cellXfs} regenerated by serializer build_xlsx_styles_xml; missing cellStyles, dxfs, colors.
XlsxFont {name,sz,b,i,u,strike,color}; missing charset/family/scheme/vertApply/vertAlign.
XlsxFill {patternType, fgColor, bgColor}; pattern types folded to strings, indexed/theme color resolution partial.
Gradient fills (type, degree, stops) absent.
XlsxBorder covers left/right/top/bottom/diagonal sides; missing diagonalUp/diagonalDown flags.
XlsxNumFmt stored; wo-sheet format.rs format_number/format_value renders a subset of Excel codes (dates, thousands, percent, currency) — exotic section modifiers and locale prefixes unsupported.

XlsxCellXf/XlsxCellStyleXf with numFmt/font/fill/border ids + alignment/protection; apply* flags present on styleXf only. wo-sheet CellStyle is a flat rendered struct, xf indices are not preserved in the live model.
XlsxAlignment {horizontal,vertical,textRotation,wrapText,indent,shrinkToFit} and XlsxProtection {locked,hidden} map 1:1.
Differential formats required by conditional formatting/table styles absent — blocks full CF styling fidelity.
Named/built-in cell styles (Normal, Good/Bad/Neutral...) absent; style names lost on round-trip.
Legacy indexed palette (used by old xlsx) not mapped — indexed colors render wrong.
Table style definitions absent (paired with missing Excel-table support).
Rich run properties inside cells (per-run fonts/colors) absent; shared strings flattened to plain strings.
wo-ooxml extract_shared_strings -> Vec<String>; XlsxWorkbook.shared_strings and WoSpreadsheet.sharedStrings. Counts/uniqueCount not tracked.
Plain text only; runs inside a single cell (mixed formatting) are concatenated.
Rich-text runs + phonetic runs (furigana) inside shared strings dropped — CJK phonetic and per-run styling lost.
Phonetic settings absent.
Calc chain not modeled; WO recomputes all formulas on load via formula_eval — correct but slower on very large books.
xl/charts/chartN.xml preserved byte-faithfully as extra_parts (round-trip safe) but never parsed: wo-sheet can show a book with charts it cannot display or edit.
chartex (funnel/sunburst...) parts preserved as blobs only; no model.
Style/color parts preserved; never applied.
Chart plot body (autoTitleDeleted, pivotFmts, view3D, plotArea) not parsed into wo-chart::Chart.

wo-chart::model::ChartKind covers line/bar/pie/scatter/area families as a generic model, but nothing converts XLSX chart XML into it (wired into wo-slide only). Grouping/overlap/gapWidth/3D variants lost.
Cached chart data + range references not parsed; multi-level categories unsupported.
wo-chart::Axis {position, scale} generic; no xlsx mapping, missing tick labels, crosses, major/minor units, dispUnits.
wo-chart ChartTitle/Legend/ChartDataLabel exist with layout basics; rich text (txPr), manual layout, delete flags unmapped.
Trendlines and error bars absent from wo-chart.
Bubble/radar/surface/stock/3D chart kinds not in ChartKind.
Pivot-chart linkage and per-format pivot styling absent.
Chart-sheet print settings absent (same gap as worksheet pageSetup).
drawings inside charts (userShapes anchors) not modeled.
xl/drawings/drawingN.xml preserved via extra_parts; images/shapes invisible in wo-sheet view.
Two-/one-cell and absolute anchors (EMU geometry) not modeled; no float layer in wo-sheet.
Shape-to-cell attachment (fmla, form-control client data) absent.
xl/commentsN.xml + VML travel via extra_parts; no comment model in wo-sheet (unlike Docx comments in wo-ooxml).
Modern threaded comments (persons, mentions, replies) absent.
Legacy comment VML preserved as blob.
Form controls (checkbox, spin button, list box) absent — interactive sheets degrade.
OLE embedding absent; object parts preserved as blobs.
externalLink parts not parsed; external references in formulas fall back to #REF after round-trip edits.
Cached external cell values absent.
Names scoped to other workbooks absent.
DDE/OLE automation links absent.

wo-sheet pivot.rs PivotTableConfig {row_fields, col_fields, value_fields, filter_fields, grand totals} + PivotEngine::create_pivot recompute from source data; layout/items/format info of the file model unmapped.
PivotField (axis placement) maps; missing sort (autoSortScope), top/bottom autofilter, subtotalTop, multiple items selection.
PivotValueField + AggFunc covers 11 consolidations (Sum..VarP); missing showDataAs (% of, running totals) and baseField/baseItem.
filter_fields approximates report filters; no multi-item selection (pageItem per-field).
Cache-file model (cacheFields, sharedItems, refresh info) absent — WO pivots always recompute from the sheet.
Cached record set absent.
Field grouping (date/number ranges, OLAP hierarchies) absent — grouped pivots collapse.
Calculated items absent.
Pivot style name/band options absent (paired with missing table styles).
Pivot-scoped conditional formats absent.
OLAP hierarchies/measures absent.
extLst (filter privacy, dimension overrides) absent.
Linked-data cell values (stocks/geography) absent; cell shows fallback text only.
Rich-value schemas absent.
Type registry parts absent; images-in-cells (rc:Image) lost.
Slicer caches absent — slicers drop to empty shapes.
Slicer view model absent (no float layer anyway).
Slicer styles absent.
Timeline caches absent.
Timeline visuals absent.
Named sheet views (per-view sort/filter) absent.
Excel tables (banded rows, totals row, structured refs like Table1[Col]) not modeled — formulas with structured refs evaluate as errors.
No autofilter model in wo-sheet; saved filter criteria lost.
wo-sheet SheetOp::Sort {range, keys: Vec<SortKey{col, order}>} covers persisted sorting semantics at op level (not file side).
Query tables absent.
External data connections absent.
XML round-trip mapping absent.
Per-table style reference absent.
